correctness.rationale: Primitive rank-one decomposition with a |R^×| quotient and generating-character orthogonality give an exact integral P_m. The radical-divisible complement is handled by a q^4 lift and a two-level induction. Bases at m=0,1, complete m=3 Smith table, multiplicities and norm are directly computed; all coefficients have independent cyclic-ring and dual-number transform checks. No extrapolation is used for the universal claim.

originality.rationale: The new all-length two-step character-sum recurrence, including arbitrary chain-ring characteristic, and the length-three sign/norm specialization were compared against Cao 2011, Choosuwan et al. 2016, Watanabe 2026, relevant recorded research, and targeted literature searches. Watanabe explicitly subsumes the length-two Galois-ring case; its stated theorem is for nilpotency length two and does not imply the all-length statement without the new induction. No verified source evaluated the length-three sharp norm. Residual risk: unlocated earlier higher-length association-scheme spectral tables.
residual_risks: Some higher-nilpotency generalized Krawtchouk or matrix association-scheme literature may implicitly supply the same recursion.

value.rationale: The determinant-zero locus is the canonical 2-by-2 singular matrix hypersurface. A characteristic-independent Fourier recurrence for all finite chain-ring lengths provides structural spectral information not given by determinant cardinalities or length-two scheme tables. The evaluated length-three sign classes and exact sharp l1/linfty projection norm supply a natural, nontrivial harmonic invariant.
